title: The Strategic Use of a Waiting List
short_teaser: A waiting list can measure demand, manage capacity, and keep communication honest.
story: A waiting list can measure demand, manage capacity, and keep communication honest. A constraint can become a source of information. Strategy means choosing what matters most and placing effort where it can create the greatest useful change. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
